stories.title: Bitcoin's 23% Rally Pushes Miner Stocks Past AI Stocks
stories.summary: Bitcoin rallied 23%, and battered mining stocks surged past AI stocks in the same stretch. A separate report says bitcoin shows a 'bottom signal,' but six months of data suggest a trap for buyers who enter too early.
stories.whyItMatters: Miner stocks track bitcoin's price closely, so a sharp rally there signals renewed risk appetite in crypto markets.
whatToWatch: Whether the rally holds or reverses, per the trap warning
Miner stock performance relative to bitcoin's price
questions: Is the bottom signal reliable, or is this rally a false start?
How long can miners stay ahead of AI stocks?

sources.title: Bitcoin’s bottom signal is flashing, but six months of data shows a trap waiting for early buyers
Bitcoin’s 23% rally sends beaten-down miners soaring past AI stocks

stories.title: Charles Schwab Adds Solana, Avalanche, Chainlink to Its Crypto Platform
stories.summary: Charles Schwab added Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink to its new crypto trading platform. The platform is still in an early stage.
stories.whyItMatters: A major brokerage expanding altcoin access signals growing mainstream acceptance beyond bitcoin and ether.
whatToWatch: Further asset additions to Schwab's platform
Trading volume once the platform matures
questions: Which assets get added next?
How does Schwab choose which tokens to list?

stories.title: SEC Sends Crypto Custody Rule Overhaul to White House for Review
stories.summary: The SEC sent a rewrite of its crypto custody rules to the White House for review. Key details of the new rules have not been disclosed yet.
stories.whyItMatters: Custody rules decide how institutions can hold digital assets, so this directly affects institutional adoption.
whatToWatch: The outcome and timing of the White House review
Disclosure of the rule's specific provisions
questions: What will the new custody rules actually require?
When will the review conclude?

stories.title: Ledger Says It Wasn't Hacked; Vulnerable Ethereum App Was Already Patched
stories.summary: Ledger denies reports of a hack. The company says a vulnerable Ethereum app was patched before anyone exploited it.
stories.whyItMatters: Ledger secures hardware wallets for many crypto holders, so any breach claim raises immediate security concerns.
whatToWatch: Confirmation from independent security researchers
Whether affected users report any losses
questions: What was the vulnerability, and how was it found?
Did any funds move before the patch?

stories.title: Morgan Stanley Leads $9M in Solana ETF Inflows as SOL Tops $100
stories.summary: Solana ETFs took in $9 million, led by Morgan Stanley. SOL's price rose above $100 in the same period.
stories.whyItMatters: Inflows from a major bank show institutional demand is spreading beyond bitcoin and ether ETFs.
whatToWatch: Whether inflows continue at this pace
SOL's price movement relative to the broader market
questions: How much of the inflow is bank proprietary money versus client demand?

stories.title: Bitcoin Eyes Resistance as Jackson Hole Opens With Unusual Fed Agenda
stories.summary: Bitcoin approaches a major resistance level as the Jackson Hole conference begins. Reports describe the Fed's agenda for the event as unusual.
stories.whyItMatters: Fed commentary at Jackson Hole often moves risk assets, including bitcoin, through interest rate signals.
whatToWatch: Statements from Fed officials during Jackson Hole
Bitcoin's reaction if it breaks the resistance level
questions: What makes this year's Fed agenda unusual?
Will bitcoin break through resistance or reject it?

stories.title: Bitcoin ETF Inflows Slow to $232M as BTC Holds Under $80K
stories.summary: Bitcoin ETF inflows dropped to $232 million. BTC's price stayed below $80,000.
stories.whyItMatters: Slowing ETF inflows can signal cooling institutional demand, a key driver of bitcoin's recent price moves.
whatToWatch: Whether inflows recover or continue to slow
BTC's ability to break above $80K
questions: Is the slowdown a pause or a trend reversal?

stories.title: Bitcoin Eyes $81K as Nvidia's Earnings Beat Lifts Risk Assets
stories.summary: Bitcoin approached $81,000 after Nvidia's earnings beat lifted risk assets broadly. The move ties bitcoin's price to strength in tech stocks.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitcoin's correlation with tech earnings shows it still trades as a risk asset, not purely as an independent hedge.
whatToWatch: Whether bitcoin holds its gains after the Nvidia rally fades
Its correlation with equities in coming sessions
questions: How long will bitcoin keep tracking tech stock sentiment?

stories.title: CZ Says Bitcoin Could Overtake Gold in the Next Bull Run
stories.summary: Binance founder Changpeng Zhao (CZ) said bitcoin could overtake gold in market value during the next bull run. This is his personal prediction, not a confirmed market development.
stories.whyItMatters: CZ remains an influential voice in crypto, but this prediction is speculative and should be weighed against gold's much larger market size.
questions: What time frame or evidence backs this prediction?
Does CZ have a financial stake in bitcoin's price rising?

sources.title: Bitcoin Could Overtake Gold in the Next Bull Run: Binance Founder CZ

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs Draw $2.8B Over Eight Days as BTC Tests $80K
stories.summary: Bitcoin ETFs pulled in $2.8 billion over an eight-day inflow streak. BTC tested the $80,000 level during this stretch.
stories.whyItMatters: Sustained ETF inflows are a key gauge of institutional demand behind bitcoin's price action.
whatToWatch: Whether the inflow streak extends further
BTC's move past, or rejection at, $80K
questions: What is driving the sustained institutional buying?

Future tokenized offerings on the platform

What asset or business does the raise fund?

stories.title: AI-Found Bugs Push Bitcoin's Core Lightning Into Secret 14-Day Lockdown
stories.summary: A wave of bugs found by AI tools forced Bitcoin's Core Lightning implementation into an emergency lockdown. The lockdown reportedly lasted 14 days and was kept secret at the time.
stories.whyItMatters: Lightning Network security issues affect bitcoin's main payment layer, and the secrecy around the lockdown raises disclosure questions.
whatToWatch: Full disclosure of the bugs and their severity
Whether any user funds were at risk during the lockdown
questions: Why was the lockdown kept secret?
Were any user funds affected during the 14 days?

sources.title: Onslaught of AI-found bugs forces Bitcoin’s Core Lightning into a secret 14-day emergency lockdown
